description_full:
NoLimit Indonesia is looking for a Graphic Design Intern to join our team! If you enjoy creating eye-catching visuals and exploring creative ideas, this could be the perfect opportunity for you to grow and gain hands-on experience.

What you’ll do:
- Create visual content for social media platforms
- Design infographics and editorial visuals
- Assist in designing email marketing materials
- Develop templates for reports, proposals, and presentations
- Collaborate with the marketing team to maintain brand consistency

What we’re looking for:
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign); Figma is a plus
- Good understanding of social media design trends
- Strong attention to detail and brand guidelines
- Good English communication skills
- Proactive, open-minded, and eager to learn

Work Location: On the road
